title: In 1932, Australia Went to War Against Emus. The Emus Won
thumbnail_text: Australia lost a war to emus

scenes.text: In 1932, Australia went to war against emus. The emus won.
Twenty thousand emus were wrecking wheat farms. So the army sent two machine guns and ten thousand bullets.
The birds scattered, sprinted off, and kept running after being hit. One gun jammed after twelve kills.
A week in: 2,500 rounds gone, a few dozen emus down. The commander said they faced machine guns like tanks.
A month later the soldiers went home. The emus are still there. So yes, Australia lost a war to a bird.

description:
In 1932, Australia went to war against emus. The emus won.
Around 20,000 emus were destroying wheat crops in Western Australia, so the army sent Major Meredith with two Lewis machine guns and 10,000 rounds. After a week, roughly 2,500 rounds had been fired and only a few dozen birds confirmed dead. Meredith reported that emus could face machine guns with the invulnerability of tanks.
Which animal would you least want to fight a war against?
first_comment: Bonus: farmers asked the army for help again in 1934, 1943 and 1948. Every request was refused. Which animal would you least want to fight a war against?
